run.name: Genmab A/S
run.title: CP-OS host session (GMAB)
run.summary: Genmab's royalty income is strong and net debt is falling, but it borrowed to buy a pipeline asset and its largest royalty has a finite horizon, so the credit is sound but leveraged and only partly assessable. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is GENMAB A/S.

cash.basis: Cash. Note 8 lists four borrowing instruments and no revolver line, but that does not establish availability, letters of credit or covenant-conditional access. No restricted cash line is presented.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.

CP-2 main limitation: Debt maturities, coupons, covenant levels, revolver availability, ratings and full-year 2025 depreciation are not supplied, so leverage on EBITDA, liquidity headroom and refinancing timing cannot be tested.

CP-1 main limitation: Full-year 2025 depreciation and amortization, revolver availability, covenant levels and debt maturities are not supplied, so EBITDA leverage, undrawn liquidity and covenant headroom are missing.
